obligations.mechanism: PKCS7_dataInit writes RAND_bytes_ex(ivlen) into unsigned char iv[EVP_MAX_IV_LENGTH] and hands the same buffer to EVP_CipherInit_ex

reachability.not_reachable_from_asn1_alone: The cipher is PKCS7_ENC_CONTENT.cipher. The item template (src/pkcs7/pk7_asn1.rs:1151-1174) has only content_type, algorithm and enc_data, and has no d2i callback; grep shows the field is written only by PKCS7_set_cipher (src/pkcs7/pk7_lib.rs:1303). A parsed attacker-supplied envelope therefore leaves cipher == NULL and PKCS7_dataInit refuses at the CIPHER_NOT_INITIALIZED arms before the cipher block. OpenSSL-3.6.4 has the same template shape (forensics/authorities/src/openssl-3.6.4/crypto/pkcs7/pk7_asn1.c:198-202), so this is not a conversion-only property.
reachability.reachable_at_the_c_abi: EVP_CIPHER_get_iv_length returns cipher->iv_len unchecked (src/evp/cipher.rs:1186-1192). A METH cipher built with EVP_CIPHER_meth_new + EVP_CIPHER_meth_set_iv_length can carry any iv_len (src/evp/cipher.rs:1457,1538) and is accepted by PKCS7_set_cipher whenever its nid is not NID_undef (src/pkcs7/pk7_lib.rs:1273-1313). A provider cipher reports ivlen as a size_t that evp_cipher_cache_constants stores as an int with no bound (src/evp/cipher.rs:594-632), so a third-party provider with ivlen > 16 reaches the same write.
reachability.demonstrated: pk7_doit_iv_longer_than_the_fixed_buffer_is_refused drives a METH AES-128-CBC cipher with iv_len 32 through PKCS7_set_cipher and PKCS7_dataInit. Pre-fix that call reached RAND_bytes_ex(libctx, iv.as_mut_ptr(), 32, 0) with iv: [u8; 16].
reachability.conclusion: Attacker-reachable when the application selects the cipher from untrusted input (for example name/OID to EVP_CIPHER_fetch) or loads a provider that reports ivlen > 16. Not demonstrated from a parsed PKCS#7 alone; no in-tree cipher definition with iv_len > 16 was found (legacy statics use 0/8/16; provider rows pass ivbits <= 128). The precondition is now structural regardless.

obligations.pre_fix: if (ivlen > 0) RAND_bytes_ex(libctx, iv, ivlen, 0); with iv declared [c_uchar; 16]; key had the same shape for EVP_CIPHER_CTX_rand_key.
obligations.fix: After reading keylen/ivlen, refuse ivlen > 0 && ivlen as usize > EVP_MAX_IV_LENGTH and refuse keylen > 0 && keylen as usize > EVP_MAX_KEY_LENGTH. Both raise PKCS7_DOIT_CIPHER_LENGTH_REFUSED (ERR_LIB_PKCS7, ERR_R_PASSED_INVALID_ARGUMENT, authority coordinates crypto/pkcs7/pk7_doit.c:325, the declined RAND_bytes_ex) and return NULL, which is the authority's failure shape for the surrounding block. Non-positive lengths keep the authority's own control flow.
obligations.divergence: Inputs the authority would write past a stack buffer are refused with NULL + one error instead of executing undefined behaviour (AGENTS.md section 17, UB in the C authority: do not reproduce). Every length that fits is unchanged.
obligations.related_finding: The same mechanism exists for the key buffer (EVP_CIPHER_CTX_rand_key writes the context's key length into key[EVP_MAX_KEY_LENGTH]); it is guarded in the same check. No dedicated test constructs keylen > 64.

obligations.mechanism: BIO filter-chain construction and teardown in PKCS7_dataInit
obligations.pre_fix: The digest chain was a bare `out: *mut Bio`; only the authority's single err: label (which the Rust port has no equivalent of) released it. Eight direct BIO_free_all calls existed, seven of them releasing only the pending btmp/bio and none releasing an already-built `out` chain.
leak_paths_fixed: md_sk digest loop: pkcs7_bio_add_digest fails after earlier digest filters are linked -> `out` leaked.
BIO_new(BIO_f_cipher()) returns NULL -> digest chain `out` leaked.
RAND_bytes_ex failure -> digest chain `out` leaked (btmp was freed).
first EVP_CipherInit_ex failure -> digest chain `out` leaked (btmp and fetched cipher were freed).
pkcs7_encode_rinfo failure for any recipient -> same.
BIO_new(BIO_s_null()) / BIO_new(BIO_s_mem()) returning NULL after filters were built -> filters leaked.
BIO_write short write into the memory sink (the sink was freed, the built filters were not).
obligations.fix: OwnedChain (Drop = BIO_free_all) holds the head of the chain under construction; a second OwnedChain holds the cipher filter until the success path links it into the chain. Every failure return now drops both owners. The success path transfers the head with into_raw after absorbing the content sink and/or linking the caller's chain. The caller-supplied bio is never adopted: it is pushed into the result on success, or returned unchanged when there are no filters.
obligations.ownership_proof: Each filter is constructed by exactly one BIO_new in this file and is owned either by the local cipher owner or by the chain owner until it is linked (ownership moves, never duplicates). into_raw is the only escape and is reached only after the final link and os release. The authority's err: tail (ASN1_OCTET_STRING_free(os), EVP_CIPHER_free(fetched_cipher), BIO_free_all(out), BIO_free_all(btmp)) is now expressed as guards plus the two explicit frees that are not chain owners.

production_unsafe_blocks_textual.note: The count is not the metric. The additions are the owner's two linkage/release operations (BIO_push in absorb, BIO_free_all in Drop, each with a SAFETY contract) and a restructured xalg->parameter read, offset by one deleted compound block.

not_established: No in-tree cipher was exhaustively enumerated for iv_len > 16; the claim is limited to the definitions inspected (legacy statics 0/8/16, provider ivbits <= 128) and to the fact that the precondition is now enforced independently of that enumeration.

Attacker reachability without application cooperation (a parsed PKCS#7 selecting a long-IV cipher) is excluded for this implementation and the authority by the template shape, but a downstream application that maps untrusted input to a fetched cipher is out of this file's scope and was not audited.
The key-buffer branch of the same guard has no dedicated test.

secret key material in the stack `key` array is still cleansed only on the success path, as in the authority (OPENSSL_cleanse at the end of the cipher block). Failure paths after EVP_CIPHER_CTX_rand_key still leave the key bytes on the stack; recorded as a retained obligation and not changed in this batch.
Full library suite, adversarial probes, Miri/ASan and differential courts were not run (FAST gate only).
